30.translation: He whose fidelity ends in the unseen. This means that when the unseen that gives happiness such as sons and others is lost, they do not become sons and others. He is the unseen-supreme and the unseen is the supreme. This means that even if his sons and others are separated, he reunites them unseen. One who thus knows that the unseen essence of the Self is the invariable cause of happiness and distress is not deluded. Therefore you should not be grieved now. Because of the possibility of seeing and combining the dead and the separated at a later time. This divine statement of Nanda is true even after the separation of Him by us and others in due course of time This is an indication of the future.
